A Winter Lunch on the Farm

Green and white stripes under a winter sun

Event
Lunch
Venue
Private Farm
Location
Delhi
Date
February 2025
Guests
120+
Category
Private Party

A garden lunch under swagged green-and-white striped canopies, with cane chairs, painted landscape backdrops and all-white florals.

Long and round tables were dressed in ivory, with green-checked plates and striped napkins that echoed the canopies above.

White roses, stock and delphiniums in green urns kept the look crisp against the lawn.

  • Swagged striped canopy
  • Painted landscape backdrop
  • Green-check tableware
  • All-white floral urns
